messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning the thermal shader + quant build cutover in the night change window (T-6h). Need: pin plan, rollback criteria, canary slice, and a short release-note blurb for CS. Who can own the runbook?
ajay: I can take lead on the canary wiring. Which build artifact are we promoting?
maria: artifact: engine-quant-20260319-shim-v7 (sha: ab12c3). Variant: matmul-v2-quantized. We want to try soft-pin first, then full roll if green.
sylvia: Important: last time we saw a thermal-related tail on a single GPU after ~45m under load. Suggest gating on p95 latency + host temp + OOM counts. My proposed gates: p95 increase > 12% OR 5+ OOMs across canary pool OR host_temp_avg > 78C -> rollback.
tom: Agree. Add a health signal for KV cache miss spike too — we've seen that correlate with bad kernels. Also suggest a 20% traffic slice for 30m then 50% for 30m before full.
deploybot: Scheduled deploy created by @ajay for artifact engine-quant-20260319-shim-v7. Canary slice: 20% across region-1 (us-west-2) start window: 2026-03-20T02:00Z. If any automated rollback trigger -> automatic unpin and notify #eng-runtime.
ajay: Quick staging run results: staging/large passed 27/30 smoke iterations. One warmstart OOM on a 24GB worker (log attached). I'm going to exclude that hosttype from the first canary set.
sylvia: tx. I'll author the release-note blurb and CS pointer. Draft: "Runtime: promoting matmul-v2 quant shim (engine-quant-20260319-shim-v7). This release targets improved token throughput with quantized matmul kernels. We expect identical model outputs; customers should report any quality regressions to support"
maria: Nice — include the fallback variant id in the blurb: fallback -> engine-quant-20260202-stable. Also add the pin TTL plan: soft-pin for 2 hours, then auto-commit to full if canary metrics stable for 45m. If we see gating signals, auto-unpin and open incident.
ops-oncall: I'll monitor host temps and OOMs during the window. Alert thresholds: OOM rate > 0.5/min or host_temp_avg > 78C for 5m. If triggered, I'll flip the safety-cordon and tag the ticket.
tom: Smoke commands for runbook (put in ops playbook):
```
# smoke generation
curl -sS https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY" -d '{"model":"matmul-v2-quantized","prompt":"lorem ipsum"}' | jq -r .text
# kv-cache sanity
kubectl logs -l app=runtime-canary -c runtime | grep "kv-cache-miss" | tail -n 50
```
maria: Good. ajay — can you add a deploybot note with the pin TTL and the rollback triggers so the bot can act automatically?
ajay: Yep. I'll add the pin TTL=2h, commit_after=45m metrics stable, canary_slice=[20,50], excluded_hosttypes=[g4dn.xlarge]. Pushing now.
deploybot: Pin created: engine-quant-20260319-shim-v7 -> soft pin (TTL 7200s). Will auto-commit after 2700s if canary passes. Notifications -> #eng-runtime, #oncall.
sylvia: Release notes pushed to docs draft. CS pointer added: cs@redwood with reproduction checklist.
maria: OK — owners: ajay (deploy), tom (runbook), sylvia (release notes/CS), ops-oncall (monitor). I'll stay on the thread through the first 60m of canary. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll set a calendar invite for the cutover and the handover 1h after start.
ajay: All set. Rolling window in T-5h now. If anything weird, ping here and escalate.
maria: Thanks team — quiet run = celebratory coffee tomorrow. :)
